jobs.title: Nursing Program Coordinator - TAVR*
jobs.description:
**The Job**
-----------

  

  

**Arrowhead Regional Medical Center (ARMC)** is recruiting for a **Nursing Program Coordinator** who will participate in quality improvement activities and support the ongoing development and effectiveness of the **TAVR** program**.** The Nursing Program Coordinator will coordinate and oversee the **Transcatheter Aortic Valve Replacement (TAVR)** program, including patient care coordination, education, quality metrics, data, and registries for procedures. Responsibilities include coordinating patient referrals, authorizations, and procedures; providing education and support to patients and families; and facilitating communication among patients, families, physicians, clinical staff, and external partners. ***Official Title:*** *Nursing Program Coordinator. For more detailed information, refer to the****Nursing Program Coordinator****job description.* **ARROWHEAD REGIONAL MEDICAL CENTER**  

Located on a beautiful 70\-acre campus in Colton, California (50 miles east of Los Angeles), **Arrowhead Regional Medical Center (ARMC)** is a state\-of\-the\-art, public/nonprofit, 456\-bed, university affiliated teaching hospital licensed by the State of California Department of Public Health and accredited by The Joint Commission. The hospital houses a regional burn center serving four counties (San Bernardino, Riverside, Mono and Inyo), a comprehensive stroke center, level I trauma center and a freestanding in\-patient behavioral health center. Additionally, ARMC operates five community\-based, primary care clinics and over 40 specialty care outpatient services. ARMC is the primary teaching hospital for the adjacently located California University of Science and Medicine (CUSM), the Inland Empire's newest medical school. ***To learn more about Arrowhead Regional Medical Center****,* ***please visit:******www.arrowheadregional.org*** **EXCELLENT BENEFITS**


To review job\-specific benefits, refer to Summary of Benefits and the Memoranda of Understanding (MOU)


The County also offers an alternative Modified Benefits Option (MBO) that provides a wage differential.

 **CONDITIONS OF EMPLOYMENT** **Pre\-Employment Process:** Incumbentsmust pass a background investigation, which includes fingerprinting, work history and education verification, as well as a job\-related physical exam and drug screening. **Schedule:** The current vacancy is for Day Shift, Monday through Friday. However, flexibility is required.  

**Certifications:** Additional certifications may be required depending on the needs of the department. **Visa Sponsorship:**San Bernardino County is not able to consider candidates who will require visa sponsorship at the time of application or in the future.
**Minimum Requirements**
------------------------


**Candidates must possess all of the following:**  

  

**License:** Must possess and maintain licensure as a Registered Nurse with the State of California Board of Registered Nursing.  

  

**Certification:** Must possess and maintain an Advanced Cardiovascular Life Support (ACLS) and Healthcare Provider level Basic Life Support (BLS) certification.  

  

**Experience:** Three (3\) years of experience as a registered nurse in an acute care hospital with one (1\) year working in a Cath Lab Unit. *Experience may be concurrent.*


**Desired Qualifications**
--------------------------


The ideal candidate will have three (3\) years of experience working in a Cath Lab Unit and possess experience in acute care settings.


**Selection Process**
---------------------


**Application Procedure****:** Please complete and submit the online employment application and supplemental questionnaire by **Friday, August 28, 2026 at 5:00pm**. *Resumes will not be accepted in lieu of the application and/or supplemental questionnaires.*  

  

There will be a **competitive evaluation** of qualifications based on the information provided in your Application and the Supplemental Questionnaire. The most highly qualified candidates, based on the evaluation results, will be referred for an interview. Be sure to include in your application and supplemental questions your experience in meeting the minimum requirements.  

  

To ensure timely and successful submission of your online application, please allow ample time to complete and submit your application. Applicants will be automatically logged\-out if they have not submitted the application and all required materials prior to the posted deadline. Once your application has been successfully submitted you will receive an onscreen confirmation and an email. We recommend that you save and/or print these for your records. *Please note, if you do not receive an onscreen confirmation and an email acknowledging our receipt of your application we have not received your application.*

jobs.title: Remote LPN/ Care Coordinator: Population Health Team Lead
jobs.description:
**Remote \| Full\-Time \| Monday–Friday**  
**Schedule: 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Pacific Time**  
**Pay: $19\.00–$23\.00 per hour**  
**Health benefits available for employee purchase**

**About the Position**

EmpowerMed Solutions is seeking an experienced and highly organized **Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN)** to serve as a **Remote Care Coordinator and Population Health Team Lead**.

Will also consider **MA/ CNA** with care management experience

This is not a bedside nursing position. The ideal candidate is an LPN who enjoys coordinating care, working with healthcare technology, reviewing data, solving problems, communicating with providers, and leading a small team.

The LPN Care Coordinator will help oversee EmpowerMed's Population Health programs and provide day\-to\-day leadership to a small team of Medical Assistants (MAs), CNAs, and Care Coordinators.

We are looking for someone who can take ownership of the program, identify problems before they become larger issues, and help keep patients, providers, and the care coordination team moving in the right direction.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Care Coordination \& Population Health**

* Support the daily operation of Population Health and Chronic Care Management (CCM) programs.
* Understand and follow established CCM and care\-management workflows.
* Review patient information and identify clinical or operational concerns requiring escalation.
* Assist with patient care coordination and follow\-up when appropriate.
* Communicate with physician practices and other healthcare professionals as needed.
* Escalate clinical concerns to the appropriate provider.
* Maintain accurate and timely documentation in the EHR.
* Help ensure care coordination activities are completed accurately and on time.

**Team Leadership**

* Provide day\-to\-day oversight of a small remote team of MAs, CNAs, and Care Coordinators.
* Answer questions and help staff resolve patient, workflow, and EHR issues.
* Monitor team productivity and completion of assigned work.
* Help train and coach care coordination staff.
* Identify workflow problems and recommend solutions.
* Hold team members accountable for completing assigned responsibilities.
* Assist leadership with maintaining an organized, efficient care coordination program.

**Data \& Reporting**

* Review patient lists, reports, dashboards, and care\-management data.
* Track completion of monthly patient activities and program requirements.
* Identify patients or tasks requiring additional follow\-up.
* Use Microsoft Excel to organize, review, filter, and analyze program information.
* Assist with preparing reports for leadership and provider practices.
* Identify trends, missing information, and operational problems through data review.

**Provider \& Practice Communication**

* Communicate professionally with physicians, advanced practice providers, office managers, and clinical staff.
* Help resolve questions related to patients and care coordination.
* Communicate program concerns and operational issues clearly and professionally.
* Serve as a resource between the care coordination team and participating provider practices.

**Required Qualifications**

* Active **LPN/LVN license in good standing**.
* Minimum **2 years of LPN or healthcare experience preferred**.
* Comfortable working independently in a fully remote environment.
* Experience using Electronic Health Record (EHR/EMR) systems.
* Proficient with **Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Word**.
* Comfortable working with spreadsheets, patient lists, reports, and healthcare data.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Ability to identify problems, investigate the cause, and develop solutions.
* Comfortable communicating directly with physicians and other healthcare professionals.
* Basic clinical knowledge appropriate to LPN scope of practice.
* Reliable internet connection and appropriate remote workspace.

**Preferred Qualifications**

Experience in one or more of the following is highly desirable:

* Chronic Care Management (CCM)
* Population Health
* Care Coordination
* Primary Care
* Neurology
* Home Health
* Medicare patient populations
* Remote patient care
* Medical billing or revenue cycle
* Multiple EHR platforms
* Supervising or leading MAs, CNAs, or other support staff
* Healthcare reporting and data analysis

**What We're Looking For**

The strongest candidate will be someone who is:

* A problem solver
* Highly organized
* Dependable and accountable
* Comfortable taking ownership
* Able to work without constant supervision
* Confident communicating with providers
* Comfortable learning new technology
* Good with data and spreadsheets
* Able to lead and support a small team
* Patient\-focused while also understanding operational expectations

We want someone who notices when something isn't working and takes initiative to help fix it rather than simply passing the problem to someone else.

**Schedule**

**Full\-Time, Monday–Friday**

**9:00 AM–5:00 PM Pacific Time**

Applicants must be available to consistently work Pacific Time business hours regardless of their home time zone.

No bedside nursing is required. This is a fully remote position.

**Compensation**

**$23\.00–$25\.00 per hour**, depending on experience and qualifications.

Approximately **$47,840–$52,000 annually** based on a 40\-hour workweek.

**Benefits**

* 100% remote position
* Monday–Friday schedule
* No bedside nursing
* Health insurance/health benefits available for employee purchase
* Opportunity for professional growth as EmpowerMed's Population Health programs expand

**About EmpowerMed Solutions**

EmpowerMed Solutions, LLC is a healthcare services company supporting physician practices through Revenue Cycle Management, Credentialing, Population Health Services, and healthcare consulting.
